scope: Development study of the L-BFGS budget alone: the v2 development recipe (same data, model, engines, Adam schedule, L-BFGS settings, seeds, training limits and physical gates) with the L-BFGS budget extended from 800 to 4,800 calls in one continuous run per (seed, engine). Primary question: does the extended budget reach physical acceptance? It replaces the cancelled v4 resumed design (a fresh L-BFGS history at a loss of about 1e-6 stalls; job cancelled after 13.5 minutes on optimizer progress alone, before any physical observation; archive 6e1b6143). The smoothness continuation arm is dropped because its source runs had already stalled at 1.1-1.4e-6 by call 800 while the baseline was still descending (user decision, 2026-10-15). Seeds 361901/361902 were observed before; no result here is a formal time-to-accuracy claim.

training.start: fresh original initialization; no direct-velocity checkpoints
training.stop_rule: none; the full budget runs and the first closure meeting both training limits is recorded with its parameters
training.engine: both: packed activation with analytic transpose, and parameter AD over the same packed forward; each compiled with CUDA Graph replay of the complete loss and gradient
training.gradient_reference: dense eager C36 parameter AD (chunk 128); preserved full native AD at the original parameters
training.maximum_training_seconds_reason: worst case for the slower parameter-AD engine: 4,000 Adam evaluations plus 4,800 calls x 25 evaluations at about 0.21 s, plus checks (about 26,300 s)
training.truncation: if maximum_training_seconds is reached the run stops before the next call and saves its final checkpoint at the cut with budget_truncated recorded; scheduled checkpoints that were not reached are absent and the observation plan skips them
training.loss_threshold_reader: box376.read_c36_v4.read_seed (protocol thresholds) applied to the training outputs after the batch; the in-batch reader is the unchanged box376.read_c36_v2

physical.state_observer: native coordinate AD of the trained curl-potential network

saved_state: scheduled checkpoints, the first training-gate closure and all loss/gradient events
gradient_checks: every 50 L-BFGS calls and at scheduled Adam updates
changes_from_v1.unchanged: data, calibration, eta, model, normalization, Adam schedule, L-BFGS settings, seeds, training limits and every physical gate

physical_observation.observer: unchanged box376.potential_physical with this protocol, in a separate all-planes batch after training (box376.run_c36_observe, chunk by the 60 GB calibration rule), independent reader box376.audit_potential_run
physical_observation.note: the in-batch observation list is empty: the unchanged v2 driver observes nothing in the training allocation
physical_observation.call_800: the LBFGS-call800 checkpoint is compared with the v2 final parameters; if bitwise identical, the earlier observation of that final stands for call 800, otherwise LBFGS-call800 is observed as well
physical_observation.observations_planned: 20 (24 if the call-800 parameters differ from v2)

decision_rule.implementation: box376.decide_c36_v5 (pre-registered with this protocol; standard library only)
decision_rule.acceptance: a checkpoint passes when the unchanged observer reports physical_acceptance_pass
decision_rule.first_pass: per run, the smallest total L-BFGS call count among the observed checkpoints (1600, 2400, 3200, 4000, final; plus 800 when observed) whose checkpoint passes; none if no observed checkpoint passes; resolution is limited to these points
decision_rule.stopped_falling: for an engine, stratified corrected pressure at final >= 0.95 x its value at LBFGS-call4000 on both seeds

outcomes_in_order.E1_all_pass: all four runs have a first pass: the budget reaches physical acceptance
outcomes_in_order.E2_one_engine_passes: both runs of exactly one engine pass and not all four do
outcomes_in_order.E3_partial: some run passes but neither E1 nor E2 holds
outcomes_in_order.E4_none_still_falling: no run passes and neither engine has stopped falling
outcomes_in_order.E5_none_stopped: no run passes and at least one engine has stopped falling

decision_rule.secondary: development only: first-pass total calls and training seconds per run, and per seed the parameter_ad/analytic ratio of seconds to the first observed pass when both engines pass at the same observed checkpoint
decision_rule.follow_up: E1 or E2: freeze a formal protocol with new seeds (fresh runs, both engines) for time to accepted accuracy; otherwise no formal claim

execution.allocation: one new ACC node, four H100 GPUs; one lane per (seed, engine), all four concurrent; training only
execution.walltime_reason: the worst-case parameter-AD training time (about 7.3 h) exceeds the default 3 h test window; the remainder covers compilation, the reader and the archive
execution.start_command: embedded in the batch script; the cluster-side driver runs admission, training, reader and archive

paired_development_analysis.statistic: per seed, parameter_ad/analytic ratios of training seconds to the loss thresholds and to the first observed physical pass, and of mean seconds per evaluation
paired_development_analysis.status: development only: seeds observed before, two concurrent lanes per engine on one node; not a formal time-to-accuracy result

changes_from_v2.checkpoint_LBFGS_calls: v2 list plus every 400 calls from 1,200 to 4,800
in_batch_physical_observation: final-first priority within a per-lane budget
changes_from_v2.unchanged: data, calibration, eta, model, normalization, both engines and their compiled CUDA Graph replay, trainer and driver sources (box376.potential_train_v2, box376.run_c36_v2), Adam schedule, L-BFGS settings, seeds, training limits and every physical gate

reproduction_diagnostic: not a gate: the parameters at LBFGS-call800 and the event-log prefix are compared with the v2 development runs of the same (seed, engine) and the first divergence is reported
